SELECT t.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.Course_ID) AS CourseCount
FROM teacher t
JOIN course_arrange ca ON t.Teacher_ID = ca.Teacher_ID
GROUP BY t.Name, t.Teacher_ID;
FINAL SQL:
SELECT t.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.Course_ID) AS CourseCount
FROM teacher t
JOIN course_arrange ca ON t.Teacher_ID = ca.Teacher_ID
GROUP BY t.Name, t.Teacher_ID;
